channel.title: Women's Wear Daily - Article Feed
channel.description: Latest articles from Women's Wear Daily (wwd.com)

item.title: Lobby PR Joins New CultureComm Group in Wave of Consolidation in London
item.description: Lobby PR is joining fellow communications agency KiNC in the new, expanding group that will see founders share resources, and broaden their reach.

item.title: An Exclusive Look at Dimorestudio’s Furniture Collaboration With Bonacina
item.description: Emiliano Salci and Britt Moran, founders of the architecture and interior design firm, teamed with heritage rattan design firm Bonacina for a luxurious, retro collection.

item.title: EXCLUSIVE: OAMC and Mykita Bring ‘Utility, Restraint’ to Eyewear
item.description: The collaboration on sunglasses drew on the practical ethos of midcentury eyewear, but realized with cutting-edge manufacturing.

item.title: H&M Group Profits Climb in Q4, as Sales Growth Holds Steady
item.description: Profits were up in the fiscal fourth quarter and year-end as CEO Daniel Ervér's efficiency plan takes hold in a brutally competitive fast-fashion market.

item.title: China Recovery Seen as Key to Luxury’s Return To Mid Single-Digit Growth
item.description: Bernstein estimated that Chinese nationals accounted for 23 percent of global demand in 2025, with top luxury companies even more exposed to the cohort.

item.title: The U.S. and France Drove Swiss Watch Exports’ December Recovery
item.description: Shipments grew 3 percent in the month to 2.1 billion Swiss francs, but exports contracted 1.7 percent for the full year.

item.title: Viktor & Rolf Spring 2026 Couture: The Dream of Flight
item.description: The design duo served up an uplifting metaphor about small changes, big results — and a handsome couture proposition.

item.title: EXCLUSIVE: Sources Say Paul Andrew to Exit Sergio Rossi
item.description: The designer unveiled his first collection for the storied Italian footwear brand in February last year. Sources also believe the Sergio Rossi manufacturing plant is changing hands and is passing on to Massimo Bonini.

item.title: Her Own Muse, Victoria Beckham Fronts Namesake Label Eyewear Campaign
item.description: “I wanted strong, instantly recognizable silhouettes that felt effortless to wear," said the designer, who was honored by the French Ministry of Culture on Monday.

item.title: Robert Wun Spring 2026 Couture: Fashion as Armor
item.description: His dramatic, sculptural creations sometimes felt witchy, occasionally Western, and at other times warrior-like.
